{{Quote|When the Empire transferred us off Kamino, we thought we were getting more training. Instead, they made us prisoners.|Stak|<ref name="Paths Unknown" />}}
'''Stak''' was a [[clone trooper|clone]] [[cadet]] who became a [[prisoner]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. Many cadets, including Stak, were transferred off [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and brought to a secret [[Imperial medical laboratory]] overseen by [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]. There, samples of the clones' [[blood]] were taken for experimentation.<ref name="Paths Unknown" />

When the Empire lost control of an [[Slither vine|experimental weapon]] at the facility, they began to evacuate their forces there. During this, Stak and his brothers [[Mox]] and [[Deke]] escaped the facility. Shortly after, the Empire called an [[orbital bombardment]] to eliminate all evidence of their operations there. Stak and the others would live in the surrounding [[forest]], being careful to avoid the Slither Vines and using their training to stay alive together.<ref name="Paths Unknown" />

One day, when Stak and Deke encountered [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] near the northern ridge, who were searching for Hemlock's laboratory. The two brought them back to their camp, where they explained to Mox that they were looking for their [[Omega|lost squad-mate]]. When Hunter suggested looking inside the ruins of the laboratory for information, Stak spoke up and said that there was no way they would lead them there, as there were too many Slither Vines and the whole area was toxic. When Deke decided to lead them there anyway, Stak tried to talk him down, but Deke refused and left, leading the two visitors towards the ruins of the base.<ref name="Paths Unknown" />

While Deke, Hunter, and Wrecker were gone, Stak tried to convince Mox to take their visitors' [[Marauder|ship]] and leave the planet. Stak saw the opportunity to finally escape Setron, but Mox refused to leave Deke behind. When Stak pointed out that the slither vines could destroy the ship and close their window of escape, Mox began to consider it and told Stak to bring him to the ship. Stak was able to hotwire the ship's door and enter, although they decided not to leave when Deke contacted them via [[comlink]] asking for help. They then flew the ship to rescue the three clones inside the facility.<ref name="Paths Unknown" />

After being freed from their solitude on [[Setron]], the three young clones were taken to refuge on [[Pabu]].<ref name="Paths Unknown" /> They later ate [[ice cone]]s there. After [[CX-2]] destroyed the ''Marauder'', Hunter told Stak and Mox to evacuate Wrecker to Shep's home for treatment, while Deke was assigned to get [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]] to treat Wrecker's injuries.<ref name="Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)">{{TBB|Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Stak was top of his class in flight training during his time on Kamino.<ref name="Paths Unknown" />

==Behind the scenes==
